description: This blueprint represents an organization in Terraform Cloud
title: Terraform Cloud Organization

externalId.title: External ID
externalId.description: The external ID of the organization

ownerEmail.title: Owner Email
ownerEmail.description: The email associated with the organization

planExpiresAt.title: Plan Expiry Date
planExpiresAt.description: The data and time which the plan expires

samlEnabled.title: SAML Enabled
samlEnabled.description: Indicates if SAML is enabled for the organization

defaultExecutionMode.title: Default Execution Mode
defaultExecutionMode.description: The default execution mode for the organization

description: This blueprint represents a project in Terraform Cloud
title: Terraform Cloud Project

name.title: Project Name
name.description: The name of the Terraform Cloud project

description: This blueprint represents a workspace in Terraform Cloud
title: Terraform Cloud Workspace

organization.title: Organization
organization.description: The organization within which the workspace belongs to

createdAt.title: Creation Time
createdAt.description: The creation timestamp of the workspace

updatedAt.title: Last Updated
updatedAt.description: The last update timestamp of the workspace

terraformVersion.title: Terraform Cloud Version
terraformVersion.description: Version of Terraform cloud used by the workspace

locked.title: Locked Status
locked.description: Indicates whether the workspace is locked

executionMode.title: Execution Mode
executionMode.description: The execution mode of the workspace

resourceCount.title: Resource Count
resourceCount.description: Number of resources managed by the workspace

latestChangeAt.title: Latest Change
latestChangeAt.description: Timestamp of the latest change in the workspace

description: This blueprint represents a version of a Terraform state version
title: Terraform Cloud State Versions

createdAt.title: Creation Time
createdAt.description: Timestamp when the state version was created

serial.title: Serial Number
serial.description: A unique identifier for this version within the workspace

status.title: Status
status.description: The current status of the state version (e.g., 'queued', 'finished')

isResourcesProcessed.title: Is Resources Processed
isResourcesProcessed.description: Whethere the resources has been processed

hostedJsonDownloadUrl.title: Download Url
hostedJsonDownloadUrl.description: Url for downloading state version in json format

vcsCommitUrl.title: VCS Commit URL
vcsCommitUrl.description: URL of the VCS commit that triggered this state version

description: This blueprint represents a run in Terraform cloud
title: Terraform Cloud Run

createdAt.title: Creation Time
createdAt.description: The creation timestamp of the run

status.title: Run Status
status.description: The current status of the run

hasChanges.title: Has Changes
hasChanges.description: Indicates whether the run has changes

isDestroy.title: Is Destroy
isDestroy.description: Indicates whether the run is a destroy operation

terraformVersion.title: Terraform Cloud Version
terraformVersion.description: Version of Terraform cloud used in the run

appliedAt.title: Applied Time
appliedAt.description: Timestamp when the run was applied

plannedAt.title: Planned Time
plannedAt.description: Timestamp when the run was planned

source.title: Run Source
source.description: The source of the run initiation

description: This blueprint represents a Terraform Cloud health assessment result
title: Terraform Cloud Health Assessment

createdAt.title: Created At
createdAt.description: Timestamp when the assessment result was created

drifted.title: Drifted
drifted.description: Whether drift was detected (actual infrastructure differs from desired state)

succeeded.title: Succeeded
succeeded.description: Whether the overall health assessment completed successfully

allChecksSucceeded.title: All Checks Succeeded
allChecksSucceeded.description: Whether all continuous validation checks passed successfully

checksErrored.title: Checks Errored
checksErrored.description: Number of resources/data sources/outputs with condition errors

checksFailed.title: Checks Failed
checksFailed.description: Number of resources/data sources/outputs with one or more failing conditions

checksPassed.title: Checks Passed
checksPassed.description: Number of resources/data sources/outputs where all conditions passed

checksUnknown.title: Checks Unknown
checksUnknown.description: Number of resources/data sources/outputs with unknown check status

resourcesDrifted.title: Resources Drifted
resourcesDrifted.description: Number of resources that have drifted

resourcesUndrifted.title: Resources Undrifted
resourcesUndrifted.description: Number of resources that match the expected state (no drift)

errorMessage.title: Error Message
errorMessage.description: Error message if the assessment failed
